h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Mau

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Mau

c: Mau in eastern Uttar Pradesh has long been a weaving town, with handlooms and powerlooms running in many homes and small units. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Mau for schools, inter colleges, residential colonies and the municipal board's parks. Our Fun Fitness machines are built at our Vasai factory, about 1310 km away, and sent by road.

Our installation team or a dealer in north India fixes them on site. Eastern UP has hot, humid summers, a heavy monsoon and cold winter mornings. Low ground can stay wet for weeks after the rains, so we plan a raised base under every machine. For a first open gym in a town like Mau, a small set of three machines is usually enough to see how much it gets used before adding more.

items.q: Is three machines enough for a first outdoor gym?
items.a: For a school or a small park, yes. Three well-chosen machines cover legs, core and shoulders. Each stands on its own footing, so you can add stations later without disturbing them.

items.q: How do we protect the machines from monsoon waterlogging?
items.a: Use a raised concrete base that slopes slightly away from the footings. After the rains, clear silt and leaves, tighten bolts and check the moving parts.

items.q: Can we get a layout drawing before ordering?
items.a: Yes. Share the size of your ground and photos. We send a layout drawing with each machine and its clear space marked, along with a quote, before anything is made.
